For the Petitioner : Mr.Rajendra Narain, Sr. Advocate
 Mr.Satyapal Singh, Advocate
 For the State : Mr.Bishweshwar Ram, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Madhuresh Prasad
 Oral Order
1. Heard learned senior counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. As per submission of learned senior counsel for the petitioner, there is sufficient material on record to show that the petitioner and the informant's granddaughter (alleged victim) who was a major, have solemnized marriage.

3. Attention of the court is drawn to orders passed by the High Court at Delhi and some joint compromise petitions to submit that the maternal grandparents of the petitioner's wife on one pretext or the other have been disrupting the matrimonial life of the petitioner and his wife.
Right from the day she left with the petitioner i.e. 08.02.2022, there has been intermittent phases when she has been taken away and thereafter resumed matrimonial relationship with this petitioner.
There is no Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.47609 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 allegation whatsoever insofar as any offence under Section 498A of the India Penal Code is concerned.

4. The police have mindlessly submitted a charge- sheet under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, oblivious of the various events which have been referred to by the learned senior counsel for the petitioner.
